problem:
Find the standard matrix that represents  the  linear  transformation $T$, where

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}2y-5z+x \\ z-y+3x \\ -z-2x+3y\end{aligned}].
$$

examples.knowledge_point: Identifying the Standard Matrix of a Linear Transformation With Rearranging
examples.problem:
Find the standard matrix that represents  the  linear  transformation $\mathbf{T},$ where

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$
examples.worked_solution:
First, rewrite the order of the variables in the usual way:

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

We require a $2\times 2$ matrix ${T}$ such that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}-5 & 4 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $\mathbf{T}$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}-5 & 4 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

feedback.problem:
Consider the matrix $T$ and the vector $v$ given below. 

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 3 \\ 2 & 5\end{aligned}],\,v=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

If $\,T\,$ is the standard matrix of the linear transformation $\,T,$ find $\,T(v).$

| $T(v)=\,\,$ |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-2}} |  |  |
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the fact that $\,T(v)=T\cdot v\,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}T(v) & =T\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-4 & 3 \\ 2 & 5\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}3 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-18 \\ -4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
